name: button
title: Button
description: Buttons and button-styled links in several variants and sizes.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base outlined button. Works on <button>, <a>, <label> and <summary>.

classes.name: btn--primary
classes.description: Solid primary color, for the main action.

classes.name: btn--borderless
classes.description: Transparent background, no border or shadow; still highlights on hover.

classes.name: btn--plain
classes.description: No background, border, padding or hover; looks like text.

classes.name: btn--icon
classes.description: Square padding for an icon-only button.

classes.name: btn--busy
classes.description: Shows a spinner while the button is disabled inside an element with aria-busy (see autosave).

variables.name: --btn-icon-size
variables.description: Size of icons inside the button.

attributes.name: disabled / aria-disabled="true"
attributes.description: Dims the button and blocks pointer interaction. Use aria-disabled on links.

examples.title: Busy
examples.description: The spinner shows while the button is disabled inside an element with aria-busy. The autosave behavior manages both for you; here a small script toggles them.
